summary.headline: Hermes and Moon Significations
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on Hermes and the Moon: their bodily, mental, social, material, and disease significations, and the effects of their conjunctions, squares, oppositions, and tenth-part aspects with other planets. The Moon is associated with bodily constitution, soul, life, conception, motherhood, domestic and civic affairs, money, travel, and silver; lunar aspects to Ares and Aphrodite bring specific fortunes and troubles.
